bug_info.bug_desc: In the pre-merge rom_ctrl_mux, bus_gnt_o was asserted from the registered/sticky signal sel_q instead of the current ownership input sel_i. In the cycle when sel_i first drops from checker ownership to bus ownership, rom_addr_o and rom_req_o already switch to the bus inputs immediately, so a bus request can be accepted by the ROM in that cycle. However, bus_gnt_o remained deasserted until sel_q updates to 0 on the following cycle. This caused the bus grant to be asserted only together with the ROM read-valid response, making the ROM appear to respond in zero time and creating a request/grant/valid handshake violation.
bug_info.fix_hint: Derive bus_gnt_o combinationally from the current ownership selection input rather than from the registered ownership state. Specifically, assert bus_gnt_o whenever sel_i selects the bus, i.e. use ~sel_i. Keep using the registered state sel_q for bus_rvalid_o so that read responses caused by checker requests are still masked from the bus.
